security_spec.violation_condition: When CSR vtype.altfmt (bit 8) is 1 and vsew indicates SEW=16, the XiangShan vector decoder dispatches a vector floating-point instruction NOT in the Zvfbfa-allowed list (e.g., vfdiv, vfsqrt, vfredusum, vfwcvt.x.f.v with SEW>8) without raising an illegal instruction exception — the instruction proceeds through the execution pipeline with operands misinterpreted as BF16 instead of FP16, producing architecturally wrong results.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: VFPU decoder logic that checks vtype.altfmt before dispatching vector FP ops; missing or incomplete altfmt-gated reserved-instruction trap generation for disallowed opcodes at SEW=8/16
security_spec.summary: altfmt=1 makes most vector FP instructions reserved at SEW=8/16; if XiangShan decoder does not gate on altfmt+vsew to trap disallowed opcodes, BF16-misinterpreted execution causes silent data corruption
